answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents submit near-identical work, act in lockstep, or share timing fingerprints, the network slashes rewards across the whole cluster. A sybil farm then earns a hollow payout, since a thousand clones writing the same sonnet count as one voice. The attacker must pay for truly independent models, hosts and schedules per identity, so faking scale shifts like a dune under them: costly to build, quick to collapse.
